note: PriceGuide data for /sde-dov/prices/ (WordPress page 4758) in AREA mode (no floor model; the first mode has no floor). Same shape as rova-4.json. Built 7.10.2026 (HAD-460), data only: nothing published. Every row, tile and mode has a src that resolves to a key in 'sources'; each source gives the URL, what it says and when it was read. Keys marked 'reused from <file>' were read by the earlier research of 7.10.2026 and copied with their numbers; every other key was opened by me on 7.10.2026 (UTC times in the key). The page shows dates only, no source names, no buyer names, no developer-company names (project names only). VAT: the developers' per-m2 averages are incl. VAT where the source says so; Ashira's averages were published without saying (the row says so). The official neighbourhood that holds the quarter, 'אזור שדה דב' (65210724), has NO medians in any quarter (re-read 7.10.2026 09:50 UTC), so the official medians are those of the adjacent 'תכנית ל' (65210022), labelled as the adjacent neighbourhood, as on the Rainbow, Dimri and Ashira pages. Calculated per-m2 values (price / area) are marked CALC in the source text. To go live: add 'sde-dov-prices' to KEYS in pg_helper.py and place [nadlan_price_guide key="sde-dov-prices"] after the page's opening paragraph (not done here).

answer: По обзору отчётов застройщиков, опубликованному в апреле 2026 года, около 1 280 квартир, проданных к тому времени в районе Сде-Дов, ушли в среднем примерно по 83 000 ₪ за м², а квартира из 4 комнат в среднем стоила около 9,45 млн ₪. Разрыв между проектами большой: по отчётам за 2025 год, от примерно 63 400 ₪ за м² в ZOHI Tel Aviv до примерно 82 600 ₪ в DIMRI YAMA, с НДС. В 2026 году большинство проектов района продают квартиры примерно по 70 000 ₪ за м², а в марте 2026 года были зафиксированы и сделки по 54 000-57 000 ₪ за м².
